verdict.rationale: Kong's own README lists logging and monitoring plugins for gateway traffic. The docs also show OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics export, but only for AI, MCP and A2A traffic, plus AI Gateway log locations. The evidence is thin on general API-traffic metrics and has nothing on tracing. Missing for 10: named metrics integrations for general API traffic (e.g. specific backends), distributed tracing integration documentation, detailed logging plugin docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor API traffic with metrics, logging, and tracing integrations

citations.quote: Plugins for enforcing traffic controls, rate limiting, req/res transformations, logging, monitoring
AI Gateway can export OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP, and A2A traffic through an OpenTelemetry AI Policy.
By default, you can view AI Gateway logs at `/usr/local/kong/logs/error.log`.
